azure.cdn.microsoft.rule.note: Azure CDN Standard from Microsoft (classic): each rules engine rule beyond the 5 included, the same in every zone

azure.cdn.microsoft.rules_requests.note: Azure CDN Standard from Microsoft (classic): requests processed by the rules engine, the same in every zone

azure.cdn.microsoft.zone1.transfer.note: Azure CDN Standard from Microsoft (classic): data transfer to clients in billing Zone 1 (North America, Europe, Middle East and Africa). Volume tiers count the transfer of every endpoint to the zone in a month: from 10 TB, 50 TB, 150 TB, 500 TB and 1 PB; the pricing page does not say whether the tiers count per profile, per endpoint, per region or per subscription, so they are pooled per region
